newsitem.title: USA: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.
newsitem.headline: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.

text.p: USDA said the 33.556 million bushels wheat, 26.364 million bushels of corn and 970,00 bushels of barley inspected in the week to Sept 26 included the following destinations (1,000 bu):
WHEAT: Lakes to Algeria 694; Belgium 284; Lebanon 626; Norway 385; Turkey 1,996.

Gulf to Barbados 101; Brazil 1,091; Cameroon 212; Dominican Republic 383; Egypt 4,033; Guyana 261; Israel 1,344; Italy 423; Jamaica 559; Nigeria 1,534; Panama 385; Tajikistan 569; United Kingdom 220; Venezuela 154; Zaire 311.
WHEAT: Pacific to Bangladesh 1,067; Taiwan 926; Egypt 4,518; Japan 1,587; South Korea 1,267; Pakistan 2,260; Peru 717; Philippines 2,689; Yemen 1,213.

CORN: Gulf to Algeria 578; Angola 52; Barbados 79; Chile 258; Taiwan 2,232; Colombia 1,617; Costa Rica 904; Dominican Republic 642; El Salvador 1,186; Germany 1,331; Guatemala 1,160; Jamaica 256; Japan 10,791; South Korea 2,170; Mexico 866; Panama 280; Poland 1,169; Venezuela 496.
